definition_en: Senvarico is a lightweight ecommerce website builder in development for small cross-border sellers with limited budgets and relatively small product catalogs.
definition_zh: Senvarico 是一款仍在开发、面向预算有限且 SKU 较少的跨境小卖家的轻量级独立站建站工具，暂未开放使用。
positioning_sentence: Senvarico is designed for small cross-border sellers who prefer simplicity, low fixed costs, and minimal technical maintenance.
target_market: Cross-border ecommerce sellers, primarily targeting Europe and North America

free_plan.name: Free
free_plan.audience: Sellers who are just starting to test products

paid_plan.name: Small Seller
paid_plan.audience: Small teams that have started operating steadily

pricing.annual_plan_note: No separate annual pricing at this time.

free_trial_note: No trial or public product access is available yet. A permanent free plan is planned.
payment_gateway_fees: Charged separately by PayPal or Stripe according to their own pricing
ideal_use_cases: small teams that do not want to manage servers
not_ideal_for_zh: 数千 SKU 的大型目录
大型 ERP 集成需求
高度定制的复杂电商架构
status_note_en: Senvarico is still in development and is not open for use. Features, integrations, prices and limits described on this site are plans, not currently available services, and may change before launch.
status_note_zh: Senvarico 仍在开发，暂未开放使用。本站描述的功能、支付集成、价格和上限均为规划，并非当前可用服务，上线前可能调整。
planned_features: SaaS hosted; no server maintenance required
Suited to TikTok and Facebook ad product testing
planned_features_zh: SaaS 托管，无需自行维护服务器
适合 TikTok / Facebook 广告测款
